text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Curren 
Chan suddenly paused.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. The smell of curry.
choice_data_list: It's dinner time already, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. Whenever I smelled 
this at home, the next thing I'd hear was 
Mom calling, "Dinner's ready!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, what did you 
usually put in your curry at home, Big 
Brother?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, what did you 
usually put in your curry at home, Big 
Sister?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup! At my place, tomato was the secret 
ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A special dish Mom poured her heart into, 
all for Dad, who absolutely hates 
tomatoes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mom's curry is the only tomato dish that 
Dad can actually eat, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we had curry for dinner, Mom and 
Dad looked so happy with big smiles on 
their faces.
choice_data_list: So this is the taste of happiness.
So this is the taste of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha♪ That's a lovely way to put it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Hey, hey, Onii-chan. If you were 
gonna eat curry—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Hey, hey, Onee-chan. If you were 
gonna eat curry—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Do you want things you dislike in the 
curry? Or would you prefer your favorites?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's something I'm not good 
with

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just like Curren's papa~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's buy some to take home. 
Curren's totally in the mood for curry now 
anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, mister!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text: Coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up going into the 
greengrocer with Curren Chan to buy curry 
ingredients...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, then make me some curry, okay? Big 
Bro♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, then make me some curry, okay? Big 
Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren has a curfew too, so hurry, hurry~.
choice_data_list: So I'm the one making it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ After all, Curren said she wanted to 
eat it, but she never said she'd make it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. But if it's just a little bit, I 
wouldn't mind giving you a hand, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it taste like happiness 
together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the curry I made together with 
Curren Chan tasted just a little bit more 
delicious than usual.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I get that! Curren might put her 
favorite things in too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mama was great at cooking, so her little 
tweaks worked out, but... Normally it's 
impossible. Just eating what I want is 
good enough!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And・then~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ufu, follow me, Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ufu, follow me, Onee-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~! Two curries, please!♪

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Brother. About what we were 
talking about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Sister. About what we were 
talking about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Why Daddy could happily eat Mommy's 
curry... Curren knows the real reason.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think it's because it was a meal eaten 
together with someone I love♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, why don't the two of us give it a try? 
I'm sure if it's Curren and Onii-chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, why don't the two of us give it a try? 
I'm sure if it's Curren and Onee-chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think the curry here will taste wa~ay 
more delicious than usual too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Curren Chan happily dug into 
the curry that had been brought over, 
relishing every delicious bite.
